title: 7 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu, Bali
metaTitle: 7 Days Yoga Retreat In Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Lead yourself towards the path of self-discovery and discovery of the Divine through 7 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali
summary: A 7 days / 6 nights yoga retreat in Canggu covering the full weekly cycle of seven pranayama techniques, Hatha and Dynamic Hatha Vinyasa, meditations, Yoga Nidra and sound baths.
intro: Experience the Complete Yogic Journey with our 7 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu, Bali. Welcome to Bali Yoga School signature week-long immersion, where you’ll experience every facet of our innovative retreat program.

Unlike the traditional programs which put you on a strict timetable, our flexible approach allows you to start your seven-day trip on any day of the week. Begin Sunday with light Surya Bhedi pranayama and body scan or start Wednesday with beach sunset flows and chakra work.

You will learn all the seven pranayama techniques we offer – starting with the basics of Anulom Vilom all the way to the advanced technique of Kapalabhati. Your meditation experience will cover sacred Om and Shiva mantra sessions, chakra awakening sessions, mindful walking meditation, breath awareness practice, loving-kindness practice, and body scan experiences, with several beach sunset yoga sessions on the beaches of Canggu.

issues: Intro claims meditation will 'free years of stored tension' and that you will have 'mastered yoga by your last day' — outcome claims, not used (paragraph 3 rewritten only by deleting clauses; review wording).
Seven pranayama techniques claim matches the 7 different morning pranayamas in the weekly schedule.
Weekly schedule says 'Join for 3–7 days', but separate 8-, 9- and 11-day Canggu retreat pages exist (with a different, older format and pricing).
Sunday schedule lists lunch (1:00 pm) and dinner (7:00 pm) while the meal note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays'.
No massages are included in the Canggu 3–7 day retreats (unlike Ubud/Uluwatu); hub copy claiming daily Balinese massages in every retreat does not apply here.
Refund policy refers to a deposit but no deposit amount or booking process is stated on the page.
No airport/arrival directions on the page.
YouTube ID gkSEJujAw2A comes from the audit embed manifest (heading '✨ Transformative Yoga Retreat – Bali Yoga School'), not from visible text.
Map embed on this page (per audit manifest) points to 'Hotel Made Canggu 77' — verify the Canggu venue.
Accommodation text: 'All our accommodations are private rooms with A/C' — consistent with private-room-only pricing.
Price for 'Course with Meals (No Room)' is labelled '20% off' but 790 → 630 is not exactly 20% off (20% off would be 632; actual 20.3% off).
Teacher names (Yogini Chiara, Yogini Shanti, Yogi Pandu) are listed twice in the teachers block (duplicate carousel).
Founder section (Yogi Himanshu) contains unverifiable superlatives ('the most honest, hard-working, authentic person we can ever meet') — not extracted.
